guide.strengths: Can deal heavy amounts of burst damage in a very short time, which gives the enemy very little time to react. One such (W) E (Q) combo can ruin the enemy laners life. Her Ultimate (R) allows her to traverse a long distance almost immediately and can provide a lot of utility in choke points. This will also give her traction to easily land her (W) . Her (E) is really effective against enemies who have some form of dash. She can thus make life a living hell for laners who rely a lot on dashes.
guide.weaknesses: Extremely squishy and can be killed if some form of crowd control lands on her. This is especially true during the early game. Her Ultimate (R) has the probability of getting her entire team killed if used improperly. She is also very vulnerable when her (W) is down. The worked ground mechanic on her (Q) can easily allow her laners to play in the middle of the lane as she can keep barraging her enemies with continuous (Q) s.

gamePlan.earlyGame: Average Keep poking the enemy with your (Q) and (E) in the lane. Try not to use your (Q) in the middle of the lane to ensure that you can regularly throw multiple pellets of your (Q) . Use the terrain to traverse the map quicker with the help of your Passive. Also, use your (W) carefully as that ability can quickly get you free kills in the Jungle. Your Ultimate (R) will allow you to roam around a lot more in this game. It will enable you to prevent enemies from entering crucial points like the neutral objective pits or separate out enemies.
gamePlan.midGame: Average Try to counter-gank and get kills in different parts of the map. Your (W) and overall burst damage will help you a lot, especially if the enemy is pushed up. Fighting near chokepoints should help you a lot during this phase of the game. You may be able to get a multi-man (W) knockup and blow squishies up easily. Set up death brushes when you can. Your abilities make it possible to one-shot enemies as soon as you get your core items.
gamePlan.lateGame: Average Just look to pick off enemies with your abilities when possible. It will help make team fights really unfair for the enemy team. Try to poke enemies out before all-in'ing them. You may need to get the Blue Buff to ensure you have enough mana to keep up the ability spamming. Use your Ultimate (R) to pick enemies off when possible. This would be a remarkable ability to use when you see an enemy on a side lane. JUNGLE PATHING Red Side Blue Side Early Game

powerSpikes.earlyGame: Her early game ganks are pretty potent as she can rotate between lanes quickly and easily displace enemies. She should capitalize on it to make sure that she can take over the game. Level 6 is a massive power spike as she can block enemies and make sure that she can show up to lanes that are being ganked. This will help her shut down the enemy. The first item component will allow her to increase her overall dueling potential. She will be doing a lot of damage as well as casting more abilities with it.
powerSpikes.midGame: Level 11 isn't a massive power spike because it provides her with nothing but a lower cooldown. It will allow her to get a lot of counter-ganks off though. Her first ability will be maxed out at level 9. This will allow her to dish out a lot of damage during duels which will be advantageous against squishy targets. Her team fighting potential is really high as she can deal a lot of AoE-based damage. Her (W) and (E) should come in quite handy.
powerSpikes.lateGame: A fully maxed out Ultimate (R) will just let Taliyah use her Ultimate (R) frequently. Other than that, it isn't an excellent power spike. Taliyah will be able to dish out a lot of damage in fights. All she needs to do is mind her positioning and not get CC'd. Taliyah will start falling off now as the enemy team will be getting defensive items now. She will need to rely on picks on squishy targets to close the game out.
